admin.intro: Find recurring log errors, see packages mentioned in their traces and prepare a support report.
admin.scanning_help: Reading recent log entries. This can take a moment.
admin.scan_failed: The scan failed. Check your administrator session and whether web PHP can read the log directory. You can retry.
admin.start_help: Scan Flarum’s storage/logs on demand. Up to 1 MiB per file and 8 MiB per scan are read. Multiline Monolog and JSON logs are supported.
admin.partial: This is a limited sample. File, byte, entry or group limits were reached. Counts and dates apply only to the entries included in this scan.
admin.no_errors: No matching entries in this sample
admin.no_errors_help: Try including all recognised levels or more log files. An empty result does not establish that the forum has no errors.
admin.choose_group: Select a visible error group to see its details.
admin.attribution_help: Attribution uses package paths or known prefixes at the start of the log message. Each package shows the evidence used. This is a lead for investigation and does not establish the cause.
admin.no_packages: No installed package could be attributed using package paths or known log prefixes.
admin.problem_placeholder: What were you doing? What did you expect? How can the problem be reproduced?
admin.include_extensions: Include all installed extension names, versions and activation states
admin.review_report: Review this text before sharing. Automatic redaction cannot recognise every personal detail or custom secret. Remove anything else that should remain private.
admin.copy_manual: Automatic copying is unavailable. Select the report text and copy it manually.
admin.report_partial: Limited sample. Counts and dates refer only to included entries.
admin.report_sample: Counts and dates refer to the scanned files and the selected minimum level.
admin.report_problem_placeholder: [Describe what happened, expected behaviour and steps to reproduce.]
admin.report_redaction: Prepared from a redacted excerpt. Request contexts and stack arguments are omitted. The author must review the text before sharing.

warnings.logs_unavailable: The Flarum log directory is missing or unreadable.
warnings.directory_limit: The directory listing limit was reached. Some log files may be outside this sample.
warnings.file_skipped: At least one log file was unreadable or changed during the scan and was skipped.
warnings.unrecognized_log: A file contained no recognised log entries. Custom log formats and truncated entries may be outside this analysis.
warnings.inventory_unavailable: Composer’s installed package metadata is unavailable. Package attribution and extension versions may be incomplete.
